personality_one_liner: A high-speed trading terminal interface built for rapid discovery and execution of price errors and coupon glitches before patching.

spacing.rule: Dense terminal spacing with compact paddings, hairline borders, and fixed tabular alignment for instant readability.

do's: Use solid obsidian and graphite slate containers with hairline 1pt borders (#30363D) for maximum scanning speed
Use tabular monospace/condensed typography for countdown timers and price deltas
dont's: No blur or glassmorphism which slows down data scanning speed
No soft pastel backgrounds or rounded playful cards

screens.name: LiveRadarFeed
screens.purpose: Real-time streaming feed of price errors, coupon glitches, and stackable promo exploits with countdown timers.

states.loading: Terminal scanning stream loading spinner with pulse effect
states.empty: No active radar signals detected. Trigger AI Scout scan or adjust filter parameters.
states.error: Terminal uplink disconnected. Retry connection button.

screens.layout: Sticky top market-status ticker banner, horizontal category & type filter chips, vertically scrolling high-density glitch cards with live countdown timers, discount % badges, and quick-claim buttons.

screens.name: AIScoutScanner
screens.purpose: Autonomous crawler and heuristic analyzer that hunts for live online glitches across thousands of merchant endpoints.
screens.layout: Interactive radar sweep visualizer at top, real-time activity log terminal stream below, and a prominent 'Execute Full Scan' button sticky at bottom.

screens.name: GlitchDetail
screens.purpose: Comprehensive glitch breakdown including AI step-by-step execution instructions, risk score, success probability, and direct shop link.
screens.layout: Hero product image with dark gradient scrim, countdown timer pill, profit delta badge, tabbed breakdown (Execution steps, Price History, Risk Analysis), and fixed sticky 'Copy Code & Open Merchant' CTA.

screens.name: StashWatchlist
screens.purpose: Saved glitches, tracked price errors, and claimed deal history with total realized savings counter.

states.empty: Stash is empty. Save live radar signals from the feed.

screens.layout: Top summary banner showing total potential savings and active watches, followed by a segmented list of saved glitches with quick-action remove/claim buttons.

screens.name: TerminalSettings
screens.purpose: User preferences for instant push alerts on critical glitches, category thresholds, and AI scout sensitivity.
screens.layout: Grouped terminal settings sections with toggle switches, threshold sliders for minimum discount %, and API node selector.

hero_radar.alt: Dark cyber trading terminal interface with neon accent

scout_backdrop.alt: Night city neon grid backdrop for AI scout

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure absolute adherence to Personality 7 (Dark-First Utility DARK - Trading Terminal Variant). Use a dark charcoal/obsidian base (#0D1117), 1pt hairline borders (#30363D), and a warm signal orange accent (#FF5722) for urgency and countdowns. All screens must use dense terminal layouts with tabular numbers. Include live countdown timers, AI Scout scanning logs, step-by-step exploit guides, and a sticky primary CTA on actionable screens. No purple, no indigo, no blue navigation bars. Zero emoji in system UI.
